sources.title: GitHub - EmbeddedLLM/vllm-wheel
sources.snippet: Easy, Fast, and Cheap LLM Serving for Everyone! [2024/11] We hosted the seventh vLLM meetup with Snowflake! Please find the meetup slides from vLLM team here, and Snowflake team here. [2024/10] We have just created a developer slack (slack.vllm.ai) focusing on coordinating contributions and discussing features. Please feel free to join us there!

sources.title: GitHub - mgoin/vllm-wheels
sources.snippet: A searchable, developer-friendly index of vLLM wheels from: release and nightly indexes on wheels.vllm.ai CUDA, CPU, and ROCm variant sub-indexes official GitHub release assets a bounded window of recent main-branch commit builds The hosted browser is designed for people. The generated JSON, CSV, and JSON Schema are designed for scripts.

sources.title: vLLM
sources.snippet: vLLM is a high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for Large Language Models (LLMs). Deploy AI models faster with state-of-the-art performance. Easy, fast, and cost-efficient LLM serving for everyone.
